# Conake Browser v0.2.2

Conake Desktop now shares the studio wordmark and typefaces used on conake.com. The active tab and New Tab wallpaper have a slow rainbow glow. Open **Settings → Appearance → Rainbow glow** to switch it off, or enable **Reduce motion** for a still spectrum.

New Tab brings your selected artwork into a wide banner. Select the scene name to change the wallpaper. Search, shortcuts, favorites and the layout editor keep their usual controls.

Available for Windows x64, macOS on Intel and Apple Silicon, and Linux x86_64.
